unsupportedMakerClaims: Maker's makerObservations blocks are near-identical boilerplate across all four answers — notably the analogyIntegrity note about a 'preserved prompting colleague comparison', which describes text present in the source excerpt but not in any of the four exact answers. The claim is inapplicable rather than false; it indicates the observations were templated rather than derived per artifact, so they carry no independent evidentiary weight here.

Maker's laidiesVoice note for MJQ-005 ('candid distinction between shorter, clearer and something the boss will read') is accurate; the identical generic voice note applied to work-ai-help and MJQ-008 overstates their register, which I score at 3 rather than 4.
Maker's dailyLifeConnection claim for MJQ-006 is weaker than stated — the anchor is a research anecdote, not the reader's own task. Does not affect the verdict.
overallVerdict: PASS — all four answers reach 20/20, 19/20, 20/20 and 19/20 respectively, every dimension at or above 3/4, and all eight hard gates pass on each. The two 3/4 voice scores (work-ai-help, MJQ-008) are honest ceilings rather than defects: both are correct, adult and unmistakably non-templated, but flatter in register than MJQ-005 and MJQ-006. None of the four exhibits the calibration failure families — no glossary accumulation, no repeated slot template across answers, no decorative analogy, no checklist-as-homework, and no scaffolding on display. Factual scope is conservatively held throughout: permission and de-identification claims are phrased as guidance and 'not a guarantee', and MJQ-006 explicitly declines to generalise the OpenAI paper's mechanism to all errors. Approved for owner preview and private internal reuse within the stated seven-day recheck window; browser rendering assessed separately.
